summary: Full frontend pass of BDesigner Requirement Form redesign (2-col desktop, image cards, custom elevation illustrations). All 8 steps executed end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) dark theme, plus light-theme spot check and mobile (390x844) entry via drawer. Every data-testid resolved, all validation errors fired correctly (steps 1/2/3/4/6/8), live pricing recomputed (₹9,000 -> ₹20,000 -> ₹36,000 across steps), elevation service triggered 8-step flow (progress bars=8), all 4 custom elevation images returned HTTP 200, registration created a new client account and closed the modal, draft in localStorage was cleared on submit. No frontend or integration bugs found.

issues: Duplicate visible data-testid="req-next" is inevitable on desktop because both mobile footer bar and desktop aside render the CtaButtons component. Only one is visible per breakpoint (mobile footer is display:none on lg), so functionally correct, but Playwright's default first-match resolves to the hidden mobile one on desktop. Consider suffixing the desktop CTA testid (e.g. req-next-desktop) OR conditionally rendering only one CtaButtons block based on viewport to remove the duplicate DOM node. Same duplication exists for req-edit, req-create-account. Not a user-facing bug — noted for test ergonomics.

action_items: (Optional/ergonomic) Deduplicate the CtaButtons render — currently both the mobile footer and desktop aside render req-next/req-edit/req-create-account. Only one is visible per breakpoint but both are in the DOM. Recommend either suffixing testids per instance or gating the mobile block behind a JS media query. Does not affect end users.
critical_code_review_comments: RequirementForm.jsx is 520 lines and mixes step definitions, autosave, submit and CTA config in one component. Consider extracting per-step components (Step1Services, Step2Details, ... Step8Registration) for maintainability — approaching the >700 line threshold as more logic is added.

Autosave effect at line 84 writes to localStorage on every state change including transient input keystrokes (dims/floors/notes). Fine for a small draft but could be throttled/debounced to reduce localStorage churn.

goNext() at line 109 doesn't validate step 7 or step 8 through the same STEPS pipeline — step 8 has its own handleRegister. That is correct behaviour but the STEP config could be a data-driven array with a validator per step to remove the growing chain of if-branches.

wantsElevation dynamically adds/removes step 6 from STEPS. If a user reaches step 6, then goes back to step 1 and deselects 3D Elevation, `step` state can remain equal to 6 which is no longer in STEPS. `stepIndex` becomes -1 and goNext/goBack silently no-op. Suggest an effect that snaps `step` back to the closest valid step when STEPS changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Requirement Form redesign is fully working. Key gotcha: data-testid="req-next" (and req-edit, req-create-account) appear twice in the DOM (mobile footer + desktop aside CtaButtons). When automating on desktop, always target the visible one: page.locator('[data-testid="req-next"]:visible').first — otherwise Playwright picks the hidden mobile-footer element and hangs. Do NOT use force=True on the navbar CTA (nav-plan-dream-home-btn); a normal click is required. Elevation images live at static.prod-images.emergentagent.com and all returned 200. Draft persists in localStorage key bd_requirement_draft_v1; clear it between full-flow runs to start clean.
